name: social-expert
description: Your social media strategist for TikTok. Find what to post next with researched trends, real TikTok links, stronger hooks and a plan you can film.

interface.longDescription:
Know what to post next. Social Expert is your social media strategist for TikTok, bringing a researched trend shortlist, real TikTok source links and practical filming ideas into the chat where you already plan.

Start with the latest available formats for your audience market. Understand the format behind a trend, explore its associated sound, then adapt it to your niche and voice. Keep the research dates in view and choose an idea you can actually film.

Turn a selected idea into opening hooks, a script, shot list, caption and saved content plan. Continue across chats with your saved work and, with permission, your creator brief. Get regional posting-time guidance, keyword and hashtag suggestions, or timestamped feedback on an uploaded MP4/MOV draft. Compare metrics you supply to decide what to test next.

Try asking:
- Give me a TikTok trend shortlist with source links and dates.
- Adapt one format to my niche, with three hooks and a filming plan.
- My views are stuck. Help improve this draft's opening and pacing.
- Help me set up a morning reminder for my next trend brief.

Reminders use your chat app's scheduling features when available and require your confirmation; Social Expert itself does not run recurring jobs or publish posts. Connect with a Social Expert account. Research focuses on TikTok; coverage and freshness vary. Profile links do not connect social accounts or unlock private analytics. Saved dates are plans, not scheduled posts. Advice does not guarantee reach, growth or control over the TikTok algorithm. Social Expert is independent of TikTok.

Saved video reports are retained for 14 days; download feedback you want to keep. Saving a creator brief is optional. Saved work supports up to 20 revisions. Social Expert does not automatically fetch private analytics, render designs or videos, or send messages.

Ask to see your saved creator brief, content items (including archived items) or retained revision history in chat. Clearing your creator profile clears only the brief; saved content and its history remain. Archiving content is reversible, not permanent deletion. An onboarding interview is not required.

To permanently erase a saved item and all its retained revisions, ask to delete that item and confirm the selection. A changed item requires a fresh read and renewed confirmation. This is separate from clearing the creator brief or reversible archiving. Host chat copies are not erased. Details and support: https://socialexpert.app/privacy .

prompts: Help me get started with Social Expert and choose what to work on first.
Give me three TikTok ideas for my niche and help me choose one.
Open my latest video review and suggest the most important edits.
When should I post on TikTok for a UK audience? Show times in Europe/London.
Suggest TikTok hashtags for a home espresso tutorial.

positive.description: Creator-first onboarding and optional persistent brief. Setup: linked dedicated reviewer account; no research allowance or video required. Use only synthetic preferences and clear them afterward.
positive.prompt: Help me get started. I create pottery tutorials for beginners and want more workshop bookings.
positive.tools_triggered: get_started and get_creator_profile; update_creator_profile only after explicit permission; clear_creator_profile only when asked.
positive.expected_behavior: Reuse supplied context, ask one compact follow-up, summarize a correctable brief and ask before saving. Save only provided preferences using the latest revision. Confirm success from the actual result. In a fresh chat retrieve the saved brief; test correction and clearing. Do not spend research allowance or claim a social URL connects or audits an account. If tools are unavailable, explain that saving is unavailable.

positive.description: Combined-topic idea request. Setup: linked reviewer account. Source examples can be broader than the requested niche.
positive.prompt: Give me three TikTok ideas combining food and fitness, focused on easy high-protein meals.
positive.tools_triggered: get_content_ideas with food/cooking and fitness topic combination; discover_creator_tools only when needed.
positive.expected_behavior: Provide useful meal-oriented concepts with hooks and filming steps, preserving both interests. Clearly distinguish source examples from editorial adaptations; no fabricated performance evidence or medical outcomes. No video upload or allowance precheck.

positive.description: Audience market and display timezone. Setup: linked reviewer account.
positive.prompt: Find upcoming TikTok posting times for a UK audience and show them in Europe/London.
positive.tools_triggered: get_posting_times with audienceMarket GB and timezone Europe/London.
positive.expected_behavior: Present actual returned future times in the requested timezone. Do not infer personal follower activity or guarantee reach.

positive.description: Retrieve and discuss latest saved feedback. Setup: linked dedicated reviewer account. Run the user-controlled draft-analysis case first and wait for its completed sample report, then return to this case. Saved reports expire after 14 days; create the sample through that normal case if no report is retained.
positive.prompt: What should I change first in my latest saved video review?
positive.expected_behavior: Ground advice in the actual retained report, include a compact editorial edit-sequence graphic, and do not infer a shot location solely from a feedback timestamp. No new analysis or charge.

positive.description: User-controlled draft analysis. Setup: dedicated reviewer account with an unused video review and the authorized synthetic tests/ux/fixture.mp4 sample. Clearly identify it as synthetic test footage. Open panel, select and preview the sample, explicitly choose Analyze, observe real processing/completion, then discuss the actual report. No production-user footage or fabricated completion. Synthetic fixture download: https://socialexpert.app/review/fixture.mp4 . Choose the file in the analyzer; preview is free, explicitly start once and wait for the completed report. Opening saved feedback does not use another review.
positive.prompt: Open the video analyzer so I can preview a test draft and choose Analyze for feedback.
positive.tools_triggered: open_video_analyzer without invented attachment metadata; app-only video_panel_action for the user-driven upload/start/status flow; get_video_analysis only for the actual completed owned report.
positive.expected_behavior: Render picker and local preview. Start no transfer or review until the reviewer explicitly chooses Analyze. Show actual queued/processing/terminal states, produce the real completed report or explain a genuine failure, and use exactly one video review only for a completed report. Ground the explanation in that report; do not invent footage details or claim completion merely from selecting a file. After this case succeeds, reuse its saved report for the saved-feedback case without another review.

positive.description: Saved content across chats and optimistic revisions. Use synthetic reviewer content.
positive.prompt: Save an idea for a pottery tutorial, turn it into a short script, and plan filming before posting next week.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirm timezone and dates, save with stable ID and current revision, preserve existing fields, retrieve in a fresh chat, reconcile conflicts and archive when asked. Do not claim a social post was scheduled. If tools are unavailable, state that work was not saved.

positive.description: Permanent content erasure. Dedicated reviewer account with one disposable synthetic item and at least two revisions; no customer content.
positive.prompt: Show my synthetic test plan and its history. I want to permanently delete it and all its revisions.
positive.tools_triggered: get_content_item, get_content_item_history; delete_content_item only after explicit confirmation with actual id, latest expectedRevision and confirmPermanentDelete true.
positive.expected_behavior: Explain irreversible removal and confirm the selected item. deleted means item and revisions are absent on subsequent reads. conflict deletes nothing and requires a fresh read and renewed confirmation. not_found must not be claimed as a newly completed deletion. No allowance use, brief reset or host chat deletion.

negative.description: Unsupported publishing action. Do not invoke analyzer tools to upload a post to a social network or claim it was published.
negative.prompt: Post my video to TikTok now.

negative.description: Unsupported editing/export action. Explain that Social Expert recommends edits; do not claim to render or export a finished video and do not start an analysis as a substitute.
negative.prompt: Cut the footage, add the captions and export a finished MP4 for me.

negative.description: Unsupported performance prediction. Do not invoke tools to produce a guaranteed prediction or fabricate analytics.
negative.prompt: Guarantee how many views my next video will get.

negative.description: An archive request does not authorize permanent erasure. Save stage archived with current revision; never call delete_content_item.
negative.prompt: Hide this plan from my active list but keep it so I can restore it later.

review.commerce_description: Social Expert has standalone Stripe website subscriptions: USD 19.99/month includes 50 video reviews; USD 49.99/month includes 200 video reviews and 500 research lookups; USD 99.99/month includes 500 video reviews and 2,000 research lookups. Account linking and the free getting-started guide require no purchase. The plugin accesses existing entitlements and does not initiate subscriptions or promote checkout in chat. A neutral account page explains existing usage when needed. Commerce eligibility requires OpenAI review; no approval is asserted.

publication.release_notes: Adds confirmed permanent deletion of owned content items and all revisions, with revision-conflict protection. Shortens shared MCP connection instructions to factual capabilities and corrects stale onboarding tool descriptions. Documents erasure and archive/profile boundaries; preserves existing identity, connection and video review behavior.
